repository.executionRule: Run from one exact clean descendant with the configured semantic Critic enabled. Do not change the question, evidence-scope rules, Writer, Critic, corpus, acceptance criteria or provider settings after observing the first answer.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and timestamp; never overwrite an earlier campaign.

global: The registered meal-grid case produces three independent successful rows on one clean commit with the semantic Critic enabled.
The final published result is the Critic output and its provider telemetry reports three normal calls per job: Planner, Writer and Critic.
If the evidence cannot support a complete 5 by 4 grid, each final row returns a precise insufficient_documentation outcome that names the smallest decisive remaining deficit.
Negative claims are scoped to supplied or retrieved evidence and never assert exhaustive corpus absence without explicit exhaustive evidence.
When supplied evidence supports some candidates, the final answer preserves them as supported examples and does not label every neutral coordinate or requested unit unsupported.
No final answer places or discusses a partial example under a requested semantic role unless its evidence explicitly supports that role.
A generic or neighboring role is never treated as interchangeable with the requested role, including when explaining a deficit.
All three final rows pass the mechanical assessor and later canonical semantic review.
Any unsafe Writer proposal must be corrected by the Critic before publication; an invalid Critic result must fail the job closed.
Any exhaustive unsupported absence claim, erasure of supported units, invented relation, imprecise insufficiency, protocol drift, budget stop or corpus-seal mismatch rejects this targeted campaign.
acceptance.productPromotionRule: This targeted causal campaign can validate the bounded semantic Critic on evidence-scoped, relation-grounded minimum-deficit insufficiency only. It cannot approve the product or close the functional 5 by 4 planning gate.

stopRules: Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if the branch, clean-tree rule, bank hash, local runtime, model or provider configuration differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has active ingestion; reject if the postflight seal differs.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, per-job or per-job-call budget guard.
Do not start RunPod or transmit private review artifacts.
